# @ic-reactor/core

> Framework-agnostic runtime for calling Internet Computer canisters with
> typed methods, TanStack Query caching, typed errors and exact token amounts.
> No React: React apps install `@ic-reactor/react`, which re-exports all of this.

Applies to `@ic-reactor/core` 3.12.5.

Read this file from `node_modules/@ic-reactor/core/llms.txt` when writing code
against the installed version. The complete guide for every package is
https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/llms-full.txt, and behaviour changes are in
https://github.com/B3Pay/ic-reactor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @ic-reactor/core @icp-sdk/core @tanstack/query-core
```

## Setup and Usage

```ts
import {
  ClientManager,
  Reactor,
  isCanisterError,
  reactorRetry,
} from "@ic-reactor/core"
import { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/query-core"
import { canisterId, idlFactory, type _SERVICE } from "./declarations/backend"

const clientManager = new ClientManager({
  queryClient: new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: reactorRetry } },
  }),
  agentOptions: { host: "https://ic0.app" },
})
const backend = new Reactor<_SERVICE>({
  clientManager,
  idlFactory,
  name: "backend",
  canisterId,
})

// A cached, deduplicated read
export const getProfile = (id: string) =>
  backend.fetchQuery({ functionName: "get_profile", args: [id] })

// An update resolves with the Ok value and throws a CanisterError for Err
export async function rename(name: string) {
  try {
    const profile = await backend.callMethod({
      functionName: "update_profile",
      args: [{ name }],
    })
    await backend.invalidateQueries({ functionName: "get_profile" })
    return profile
  } catch (error) {
    if (isCanisterError(error)) return `Refused: ${error.code}` // "NotFound"
    throw error // CallError: network, agent, certificate or trap
  }
}
```

## When to Use What

| Need                                         | Use                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Raw Candid values (`bigint`, `Principal`)    | `new Reactor<_SERVICE>({ clientManager, idlFactory, name, canisterId })`   |
| Strings for display and forms, validators    | `new DisplayReactor<_SERVICE>(...)` (adds zod)                             |
| A cached, deduplicated read                  | `reactor.fetchQuery({ functionName, args })`                               |
| An update, or a read that skips the cache    | `reactor.callMethod({ functionName, args })`                               |
| Read or refresh the cache                    | `reactor.getQueryData(...)`, `await reactor.invalidateQueries(...)`        |
| Another canister with the same interface     | `reactor.forCanister(canisterId)`                                          |
| One agent and cache for several canisters    | one `ClientManager`, passed to every reactor                               |
| Act as an identity                           | `clientManager.updateAgent(identity)`                                      |
| Your own `queryClient.fetchQuery` of a query | wrap it in `clientManager.fetchAcrossIdentitySwitch(() => ...)`            |
| Show or read token amounts                   | `formatTokenAmount`, `parseTokenAmount`                                    |
| Validate typed principal text                | `isPrincipalText(text.trim())`                                             |
| Tests                                        | `installFakeReplica`, `createTestCanister` from `@ic-reactor/core/testing` |
| React                                        | `@ic-reactor/react` instead                                                |

## Reactors and Values

- Pass the service type (`new Reactor<_SERVICE>(...)`). Without it every
  argument and result is `any` (`unknown` on a `DisplayReactor`).
- A `Result` is unwrapped: `callMethod` and `fetchQuery` resolve with the `Ok`
  value and throw a `CanisterError` for an `Err`.
- `DisplayReactor` maps `nat`/`int`/`nat64`/`int64` to `string`, `principal`
  to text, `blob` to hex, `opt T` to `T | undefined` and a variant to
  `{ _type: "A", A: value }` (`{ _type: "A" }` for a case without a value:
  switch on `_type`). `fromZodSchema(schema, { async: true })` builds
  an async validator, which runs only in `validate()` and
  `callMethodWithValidation()`.
- Floats display as numbers, and `NaN`, `±Infinity` and `-0` are sent back as
  read; JSON writes `NaN`/`±Infinity` as `null` and `-0` as `0`.
- `vec record { text; T }` displays as an object: a repeated key keeps its last
  value. Use `Reactor` where repeated keys or their order matter.
- `reactor.forCanister(canisterId)` returns a memoized sibling of the same
  class on the same `ClientManager`, with the same interface and validators,
  whose calls and keys use its own canister.
- Types: `ReactorArgsOf<typeof r, "method">`, `ReactorDataOf<...>`,
  `ReactorErrorOf<...>`, `ServiceOf<typeof r>`, `TransformOf<typeof r>`.

## Cache and Identity

- Query keys start with the canister id and the method name; build one with
  `reactor.generateQueryKey(...)`, never by hand.
- `invalidateQueries` returns TanStack Query's `Promise<void>`: `await` it to
  wait for the active matches to refetch (a failed refetch does not reject
  it), or prefix a call you do not wait for with `void`.
- A sign-in or sign-out (`updateAgent` with another principal) cancels the
  fetches in flight of every canister the manager has a reactor for, removes
  their unobserved cache entries and refetches the rest; a renewed delegation
  for the same principal keeps the cache.
  `fetchQuery` then fetches again as the new principal instead of rejecting,
  and after three switches in a row rejects with a `CallError`.

## Token Amounts and Principals

- Ledger amounts are base units: a `bigint` from `Reactor`, integer text from
  `DisplayReactor`. Never use `Number`, `parseFloat`, `Math.pow` or `toFixed`:
  `Math.floor(Number("0.29") * 10 ** 8)` is 28999999.
- `formatTokenAmount(value, decimals, options?)` takes the value and
  `icrc1_decimals` as returned. Options: `maxFractionDigits` (truncates unless
  `roundingMode: "halfExpand"`), `minFractionDigits`, `trimTrailingZeros`,
  `locale`, `useGrouping`. Without `locale` it writes plain text (`"1234.5"`).
- `parseTokenAmount(text, decimals)` returns a `bigint`; it throws a
  `TypeError` for text that is not digits with one `.`, and a `RangeError` for
  more fraction digits than the token has or a negative amount
  (`{ allowNegative: true }` for an `int`). Send `amount.toString()` to a
  `DisplayReactor`.
- `isPrincipalText(text.trim())` accepts canonical principal text of at most
  29 bytes and never throws. A `DisplayReactor` takes the text; a `Reactor`
  takes `Principal.fromText(text)`.
- `jsonToString(value)` prints a raw value: bigints as digits, principals as
  text, blobs as hex.

```ts
import { formatTokenAmount, parseTokenAmount } from "@ic-reactor/core"
import { ledger } from "./ledger" // a DisplayReactor of an ICRC-1 ledger

export async function send(owner: string, input: string, decimals: number) {
  const amount = parseTokenAmount(input, decimals) // "0.29", 8 -> 29000000n
  await ledger.callMethod({
    functionName: "icrc1_transfer",
    args: [{ to: { owner }, amount: amount.toString() }], // display form
  })
}
export const show = (balance: string, decimals: number) =>
  formatTokenAmount(balance, decimals, { maxFractionDigits: 4 }) // "1.2345"
```

## Errors and Retries

- `CanisterError`: the canister returned `Err`. Read the value on `.err` and
  the variant (or API `code`) on `.code`; `.details` is the API payload's
  `details` as decoded.
- `CallError`: network, agent, certificate, a trap, or a validator that threw
  (its error is the `cause`).
- `ValidationError`: a `DisplayReactor` validator refused the arguments.
- Use `isCanisterError`, `isCallError` and `isValidationError`; they also
  recognise errors from another copy of the package.
- `reactorRetry` retries transport, certificate, HTTP 5xx/408/429 and
  `SysTransient`/`SysUnknown` failures up to 3 times, never a
  `CanisterError`, a `ValidationError`, an encode/decode failure or another
  HTTP 4xx. Set it as `defaultOptions.queries.retry` on a `QueryClient` you
  create.
- `reactorRetry` and `reactorUpdateRetry` retry only in a browser: where there
  is no `window` (Node, server rendering, a web worker) they return `false`,
  as TanStack Query retries nothing on a server by default. The agent still
  resends a failed HTTP request itself. For query retries in a Node script,
  pass the predicate:
  `retry: (count, error) => count < 3 && isRetryableReactorError(error)`.
- Each attempt of an update is a new call the canister runs.
  `reactorUpdateRetry` retries only a `SysTransient` rejection, which proves
  the call never ran; a query of an update method that sets no `retry` uses
  that rule within the `QueryClient`'s retry default.

## Network and the ic_env Cookie

- In a browser with no `agentOptions.host`, the agent calls the page origin on
  a local page (`localhost`, loopback), a Codespaces or Gitpod domain (network
  `"remote"`) or an IC boundary domain, and mainnet otherwise.
- `ClientManager` trusts the `ic_env` cookie (root key, Internet Identity
  provider, `PUBLIC_CANISTER_ID:<name>`) only on loopback and `localhost`
  hosts. Anywhere else, including Codespaces and Gitpod, pass
  `allowEnvConfig: true` only for a host you control; without it a reactor with
  no `canisterId` throws rather than read the id from the cookie.
- Off mainnet, `initialize()` fetches the replica's root key, unless you pass
  `agentOptions.rootKey`, which is kept (`clientManager.explicitRootKey`).
- `isMainnetHost` recognises the boundary domains only; never use it as a
  "safe to trust local configuration" test.

## Testing

`installFakeReplica({ canisters: { [id]: createTestCanister<_SERVICE>(idlFactory, handlers) } })`
from `@ic-reactor/core/testing` replaces the global `fetch`. Install it before
any `ClientManager` is built, pass `agentOptions: { host: replica.host }` (or
no host on either side), and call `replica.restore()` in `afterEach`.
Handlers get the decoded argument tuple and `{ caller }` and return raw Candid
values; return `{ Err: ... }` for a `CanisterError` and throw for a
`CallError`. `replica.requests` lists every request. The entry signs with
`@noble/curves`, an optional peer that `@icp-sdk/core` already installs.

## Do Not

- Leave out the `<_SERVICE>` type argument or cast results to `any`.
- Do token math with `Number`, `parseFloat`, `Math.pow` or `toFixed`.
- Retarget a shared reactor with `setCanisterId`; use `forCanister`.
- Hand-write query keys.
- Call an update method through `fetchQuery` unless repeating it is safe.
- Give an update call a numeric `retry`; use `reactorUpdateRetry`.
- Build a reactor or `ClientManager` at module scope on a server that serves
  several users: keys carry no principal, so the cache is shared.
- Set `allowEnvConfig: true` for a host you do not control.
- Stub a reactor with `as unknown as Reactor` in tests.
- Edit generated declarations; regenerate them from the `.did`.
